items.title: Chandigarh court directs Meta to remove AI-generated video of Punjab MLA Sukhpal Khaira
items.summary: A Chandigarh court has directed Meta platforms to remove from Facebook and Instagram a morphed and artificial intelligence-generated video depicting Punjab MLA Sukhpal Singh Khaira in an off-shoulder women’s dress. Civil Judge (Junior Division) Kaushal Kumar Yadav passed the ad interim order on August 12 after finding that Khaira had made out a prima facie case for an injunction. “ The content uploaded is apparently defamatory, objectionable and AI generated, ” the Court said. The Court added that Khaira would suffer irreparable loss and injury if the content continued to remain accessible and circulate on public platforms. The court directed Meta, its agents and representatives to disable access to the identified video and posts uploaded on the Facebook page “Charda Punjab” and Instagram account “Chard_apunjab”. The content and identified URLs must be removed within 72 hours of Meta receiving the order, the Court directed. Khaira, who represents the Bholath constituency in the Punjab Legislative Assembly, filed the suit seeking permanent and mandatory injunctions, protection of his reputation, dignity and personality rights. items.title: Hearings not taking place for years: Supreme Court flags serious concerns with consumer forums, seeks report
items.summary: The Supreme Court on Thursday frowned upon the performance of consumer commissions across the country for the inordinate amount of time taken by them to decide consumer cases/ complaints. A Bench of Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant and Justice Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana also took note of a newspaper report which termed the performance of consumer forums as "pitiful and poor". In many pending matters, hearings do not take place for years, the Court noted. "The moment you start paying for case disposal, you will see how the disposal will multiply. The moment you keep on adding more and more infrastructure, the courts and facilities, then unfortunately this is the outcome. There is a newspaper report also in which the following issues have been highlighted with respect to the pitiful and poor performance of the Consumer Commissions, including the National Consumer Commission. The inordinate delay in disposal of the pending matters, especially when even hearings are not taking place for years," the Court said.
